_archive_candidates.reason: Real course code 303JA confirmed live only through version 2, 2025 (https://www.canberra.edu.au/course/303JA/2/2025), whose page explicitly states 'This course is not open for new admissions.' No 2026 or later version exists, and 303JA is absent from the current course.xml sitemap. UC's own live Master of Research page (MXM001, https://www.canberra.edu.au/course/MXM001/1/2026) explicitly markets itself as UC's 'new' discipline-general research masters, delivered over 18 months full time with an integrated coursework-plus-thesis structure, replacing the previous set of discipline-named research masters (Applied Arts and Humanities, Applied Science, Health, and the Professional Doctorate in Public Administration) the same way UC's PhD variants consolidated into the single MXP001 code. Real, current content exists for this award (sourced and would have been Bond-standard), but since the award itself cannot currently be applied to and has a confirmed live generic successor, it is archived rather than published with content nobody can enrol into.
